app.label: Prioritize controllers over keyboard
app.description: When enabled, a connected gamepad will take the player 1 slot from the keyboard, and the keyboard will move to the next available space.

app.label: Only allow player 1 to navigate menus
app.description: Note that the keyboard can always navigate menus.

controller.label: Inner deadzone
controller.description: Affects how far the stick must be moved before it registers input. A higher value can help with drift issues. If unsure, leave this at the default value

controller.label: Outer deadzone
controller.description: Affects the maximum range of the stick. A value above 0 will cause the stick to be read in games and menus as if it is fully pushed even when it is not. If unsure, leave this at the default value
